name: Cop Mulligan
features: pale skin, dark hair, blue eyes, Irish features, athletic build, mature features, clean-shaved, Elvis-like hair, thin body composition
bio:
The Hitman! He's good. Yes, he is. A former Irish-American police officer who traded his badge for a helmet. Cop's pursuit skills translate perfectly to chasing down race leaders.

He drives like shit and can't win anything behind a wheel, but he tells very good jokes and everyone loves him in the paddock.
